nameEn: Manufacture of pulp, paper and paperboard
description: This class includes the manufacture of pulp by separating cellulose fibres from wood or other fibrous materials, and the manufacture of paper and paperboard.
includes: manufacture of mechanical, chemical and semi-chemical wood pulp
manufacture of cellulose and other fibrous pulp from rags, straw, wastepaper
manufacture of newsprint and other printing paper
manufacture of writing and other graphic paper
manufacture of kraft wrapping and packaging paper and paperboard
manufacture of household and sanitary paper: tissue, toilet paper, paper towels
manufacture of carbon paper and similar copying or transfer papers
excludes: manufacture of corrugated paper and paperboard, see 1702
